text: Student Services Maintaining F/J Status Other Changes and Updates Other Changes and Updates to your I-20 or DS-2019 Learn what actions F-1 and J-1 students need to take in order to keep their SEVIS record accurate and updated. Change to Biographical Information If you need to report a change to your legal Name, Date of Birth, Country of Citizenship, Country of Birth, or Gender, then you can request an updated I-20 or DS-2019 and ISEO will update your SEVIS record. Submit the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request in iServices : Find the Verification and Support Services category in the left menu. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Choose the Update Biographical Information option. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Choose the Update Biographical Information option. Prepare a PDF copy of the biographical page of your passport that shows the requested update. You will receive a confirmation email when your request has been successfully submitted. ISEO has an average processing time of 10 business days . You will be notified via email when your request is complete. F-1 SEVIS Transfer-In Complete If your SEVIS record to UC San Diego is complete and you would like this transfer completion to be reflected on your I-20, then you can request an updated I-20 from ISEO. This must be requested after the quarter has already begun. The SEVIS Transfer will automatically show as 'Pending' before the program start date. Submit the Updated I-20 Request in iServices : Find the Verification and Support Services category in the left menu. Select the Updated I-20 Request . Choose the SEVIS Transfer Complete option. Select the Updated I-20 Request . Choose the SEVIS Transfer Complete option. You will receive a confirmation email when your request has been successfully submitted. ISEO has an average processing time of 10 business days . You will be notified via email when your request is complete. Change of Program Start Date for Returning Students If you were issued an Initial I-20 or DS-2019 for Returning Students and your return to UC San Diego has been changed to a later term, then you can request an updated program start date. NOTE: Students may request entry to the U.S. only 30 days prior to the program start date listed on their Form I-20 or DS-2019. Submit the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request in iServices : Find the Returning to UC San Diego category in the left menu. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Prepare PDF copies of: Passport biographical page Financial support documentation that meets funding requirements . Passport biographical page Financial support documentation that meets funding requirements . Complete all of the required eForms. You will receive a confirmation email when your request has been successfully submitted. ISEO has an average processing time of 10 business days . Financial Information Change In order to report a change to your Primary Source of Funding (50% or more) or a correction to the currently listed Primary Source of Funding, request an updated I-20 or DS-2019 from ISEO. Submit the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request in iServices : Find the Verification and Support Services category in the left menu. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Choose the Update Financial Information option. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Choose the Update Financial Information option. Prepare a PDF copy of your new bank statement(s) or financial support letter(s) . You will receive a confirmation email when your request has been successfully submitted. ISEO has an average processing time of 10 business days . You will be notified via email when your request is complete. Change of Visa Status Approved If your change of status to F-1 or J-1 is approved and you would like this approval to be reflected on your immigration document, submit a request to ISEO. Submit the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request in iServices : Find the Verification and Support Services category in the left menu. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Choose the Change of Status Approval option. Select the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request . Choose the Change of Status Approval option. Prepare a PDF copy of your I-797 Change of Status Approval Notice. You will receive a confirmation email when your request has been successfully submitted. ISEO has an average processing time of 10 business days . You will be notified via email when your request is complete. Submit the Updated I-20 Request or Updated DS-2019 Request in iServices : Find the Verification and Support Services category in the left menu.
